title: Hearth dailyforecast/v1 State
description: One daily forecast snapshot. Periods are consecutive local days in strictly increasing order; the first is today at the forecast location. Values are modeled predictions, not measurements. Omitted measurements are unavailable, never zero.

starts_at.description: Start of the local day in UTC, RFC 3339 with a Z suffix.

date.description: Calendar day at the forecast location, YYYY-MM-DD.

condition.description: Hearth sky condition. Omitted when the source condition has no Hearth equivalent.

temperature_min.description: Lowest temperature from midnight to midnight, in degrees Celsius; not the overnight low.

temperature_max.description: Highest temperature from midnight to midnight, in degrees Celsius; not the daytime high.

precipitation_probability.description: The day's maximum chance of precipitation in percent, from 0 to 100; today's value may cover only the remaining hours.

precipitation_rate.description: Liquid-water-equivalent rate in mm/h; not an accumulation.

humidity.description: Relative humidity in percent, from 0 to 100.

wind_speed.description: Wind speed in meters per second.

wind_gust.description: Wind gust speed in meters per second.

wind_direction.description: Direction the wind comes from, in degrees.

cloud_cover.description: Cloud cover in percent, from 0 to 100.
